checkpoint_review: The Router correctly identified that the 'Limbs_and_Anatomy' checkpoints (clawed digits, stubby tail) are untestable due to occlusion and blur. The verdicts for visible features (Head, Body, Fur) are accurate. The Router was not too lenient; it appropriately flagged the texture softness in the foreground fur.
artifact_review: The Router identified 'blur' and 'texture_anomaly'. The 'animal_pose_auditor' reported a HIGH artifact risk (82% low-confidence keypoints), which is significant. While some of this is due to domain shift (AI image vs. real photo training data) and occlusion, the extremely low confidence in the face/ear region (where the eye is clearly visible to humans) suggests the model detects subtle structural inconsistencies or 'melting' in the facial geometry that the Router missed. The 'topology_boundary_auditor' confirmed a clean mask, ruling out major floating parts. The 'perceptual_quality_auditor' found no global distortions. I am upgrading the severity of the structural uncertainty noted by the pose auditor, as it correlates with the 'soft' facial features often seen in AI generations.
alignment_reasoning: Strong class conformance. Fine-grained classifiers confidently identified both subjects as 'hamster' (Logit 7.86). Visible anatomical features (eye, ear, body shape) match the taxonomy perfectly. The high alignment score reflects the successful identification of the correct species and general morphology, despite the partial view.
artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from moderate artifacts. The Pose Auditor's high-risk flag (0.82 low-conf ratio) indicates structural ambiguity, particularly in the limbs and face, likely due to AI generation smoothing or incomplete rendering of complex paw structures. The Router's observation of 'soft' fur texture supports this. While the topology is clean (no floating parts), the lack of crisp anatomical definition in the extremities and the 'waxy' look of the background hamster's foot prevent a higher artifact score. It is better than the 'mid' reference (shark fusion) but worse than the 'high' reference (clean iguana).
key_defects: High structural uncertainty in limb/face keypoints (Pose Auditor)
Soft/smudged fur texture on foreground subject
Blur/indistinct rendering of background hamster's foot
